in_hebrew.name: Madella
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mother of the Lord
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Madella הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'matella', meaning 'small mother'. In Christian tradition, it is believed to be a title for the Virgin Mary.

in_greek.name: Madella
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Mother of the Lord
in_greek.long_meaning: Madella είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'matella', meaning 'small mother'. In Christian tradition, it is believed to be a title for the Virgin Mary.

in_latin.name: Madella
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Mother of the Lord
in_latin.long_meaning: Madella est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Latin word 'matella', meaning 'small mother'. In Christian tradition, it is believed to be a title for the Virgin Mary.
